d:
Smritiyan tumhare prem ki kshatipurti svarup milin
Jo tumhare hone ka bhram banae rakhti hain sada.
Har skrol men dikh jata hai hamara sath bikhra para rils dar rils,
Mobail ke ki-paid pahchante hain tumhara nam
Ek akshar taip hote hi pahuncha dete hain sanvad ke aakhiri shabd tak,
Jise yah sadi kahti hai otosjeshan
Vah tumhari smritiyon ka mashini shadyantrabhar hai.
Yad rahti ho tum
